scope: Diagnosis of an existing paid run; not a new run or semantic fix. No topic-specific production rule was added.

selected_findings.statement: 要从 TaskGroup 抛出的异常组中按类型取出原始异常必须用 except*（普通 except 只整体捕获组，except 具体类型匹配不到组内异常）。
推断：return_exceptions=False 时 gather 上抛首个异常后不再等待其余兄弟完成（文档只说“immediately propagated”且其余“continue to run”，未明说是否等待），晚失败可能产生“exception was never retrieved”。

observations: The investigator explicitly labeled the late-exception claim as inference; both draft and final report retained it next to document citations.
The author added the more general assertion that eg.exceptions contains matching leaf exceptions; the final review accepted the report.
This establishes propagation and a missed review, not the unique causal effect of a prompt or architecture. A new review role or mandatory code execution is not justified by this one case.
next_validation: Compare qualifier preservation, supported versus unsupported inference, and review reasons on contrasting non-Python tasks before any production semantic-policy change.
latency_boundary: Exported calls have admission timestamps, but no complete settle/queue/prepare spans; do not subtract summed overlapping calls from elapsed time or claim a provider/local split.
